687-1887-2034-8130.easyPrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a creature you control.
687-1887-2034-8130.description:
Activate Wall of Roots by putting two -0/-1 counters on it (due to Vorinclex), adding {G}.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control.
In response to Tayam's ability, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wall of Roots, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling yourself three cards and returning Wall of Roots from your graveyard to the battlefield with two vigilance counters on it due to Tayam and Vorinclex.
Repeat.
687-1887-2034-8130.notes: This order of operations and the {2} starting mana are necessary because you cannot pay the counter removal cost before sacrificing the creature to Ashnod's Altar, due to the timing sequence of the activated ability rules.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-4019-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Vigean Graftmage.
When Vigean Graftmage dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2557-4094-4772-6763-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

1619-2511-4605-5542-6136.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2511-4605-5542-6136.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Avenging Hunter from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Avenging Hunter enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Avenging Hunter.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Avenging Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Avenging Hunter token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Avenging Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2511-4605-5542-6136.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

670-1619-6143-6473.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6143-6473.description:
Cast Mardu Siegebreaker by paying its mana cost.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Feywild Caretaker until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, causing Feywild Caretaker to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Feywild Caretaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Mardu Siegebreaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Feywild Caretaker until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Repeat from step 5.

1170-5078-6979-7729.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using The Fourth Doctor this turn If Sensei's Divining Top is on top of your library.
1170-5078-6979-7729.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, Displacer Kitten triggers, and The Fourth Doctor triggers if you had cast Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Resolve the Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking The Fourth Doctor.
Resolve the Fourth Doctor trigger, if applicable, creating a Food token.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2511-5088-5211-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
2511-5088-5211-7443-7537.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Activate two of those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two mana.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Brass's Bounty.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Brass's Bounty from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, activate your remaining Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least six mana.
Cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve both copies of Brass's Bounty, creating at least sixteen Treasure tokens.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least sixteen mana.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Brass's Bounty with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Brass's Bounty from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve both copies of Brass's Bounty, creating at least sixteen Treasure tokens.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least sixteen mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Brass's Bounty.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 19.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

1453-4559-5256-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
1453-4559-5256-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Arwen.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2113-3459-5078-5243.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

2893-3470-4500-4826.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Retreat to Kazandu trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Retreat to Kazandu trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

2821-4474-5479-6702.description:
Activate Kilo by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte by remove a charge counter from it, untapping Minamo.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

141-1532-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1532-2034.description:
Cast Faith's Reward by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Faith's Reward.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Faith's Reward
Resolve the Faith's Reward copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2904-5639.notablePrerequisites: You have one or fewer cards in hand.
2904-5639.description:
Activate Arm-Mounted Anchor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Illusionist.
Cephalid Illusionist triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Arm-Mounted Anchor ability, attaching it to Cephalid Illusionist.
Repeat.

465-997-6132.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1090-5256-6132.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Restoration Angel.
1090-5256-6132.description:
Cast Restoration Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Restoration Angel.
Resolve the Restoration Angel ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Restoration Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

804-1912-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Sakashima the Impostor has a power of at least 2.
804-1912-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Sakashima the Impostor and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Sakashima the Impostor to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Sakashima the Impostor enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-2792-6063.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}
1170-2792-6063.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}
Cast Viscerid Armor by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Great Whale.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Viscerid Armor spell.
Activate Viscerid Armor by paying {1}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-4786-5034-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4786-5034-5131.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Claws of Gix by paying {1} and sacrificing Sol Ring, causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Sol Ring from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha.
Repeat.

662-2043-2493-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {8}{U}{U}.
662-2043-2493-4276.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Archaeomancer to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {8}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Archaeomancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Turnabout to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
If lands you control can tap to proudce at least {9}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, which can be used to activate Urza's ability infinitely and/or cast Turnabout choosing its other modes.

4186-4384-5070.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-4384-5070.description:
Gain life.
Treebeard's second ability triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2067-2542-4323.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least thirty, minus one for each poison counter your opponents have and for each creature you control.
2067-2542-4323.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
Cast Cauldron Haze by paying {1}{W/B}, targeting every creature you control.
Venerated Rotpriest triggers for each creature targeted by Cauldron Haze.
Resolve the first trigger, causing an opponent to get a poison counter.
Repeat step 4 until an opponent loses the game due to having ten poison counters, then repeat for each other opponent.

129-1562-4824.description:
Activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-1562-4824.notes: Soliton can be in any zone so long as Machine God's Effigy is on the battlefield as a copy of it.

1887-3094-3609-3933.manaNeeded: {6} each odd-numbered turn, with {4} available each even-numbered turn
1887-3094-3609-3933.notablePrerequisites: Magistrate's Scepter has at least one charge counter on it.
1887-3094-3609-3933.description:
Activate Karn's Bastion's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Karn's Bastion's ability.
Resolve both Karn's Bastion abilities, putting four charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Karn's Bastion's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 one time.
Repeat from step 1.

2290-3129-4158-4772-4929.notablePrerequisites:
Cryptic Trilobite and Spike Feeder have at least one +1/+1 counter.
Your life total is at least four.
2290-3129-4158-4772-4929.description:
Activate Staff of Compleation's third ability by tapping it and paying three life, causing you to put four +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite and Spike Feeder.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to gain four life.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding six {C} that can only be spent to activate abilitieis.
Activate Staff of Compleation's last ability by paying {5}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana and life, you may activate Staff of Compleation's other abilities.

579-2757-5285.notablePrerequisites:
You control a basic Plains.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
579-2757-5285.description:
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Angel, untapping the Plains.
Repeat.

2034-2147-4499.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
2034-2147-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Company Commander.
Company Commander enters the battlefield, creating at least two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Soldiers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

813-1987-2427.notablePrerequisites: You control an artifact or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce {U}.
813-1987-2427.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Scholar of the Ages and your untapped source, blinking them both.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Tap your untapped blue source for {U}.
Repeat.
